subject: Mesh Diffusion kickoff — textures on the surface, not in UV space
body:
Hi all,

Kicking off the mesh-diffusion texture tool. The research asset: our CVPR-published single-mesh diffusion work with field latents, where an FLVAE encodes surface texture into latent fields and an FLDM samples new textures directly on a labeled mesh — no UV-space hacks. The product bet: internal 3D-asset teams spend days per asset on texture variations we can generate in minutes.

Milestones (window through 06-15):
- 04-10: sampling flow working end-to-end from our FLVAE/FLDM checkpoints on preprocessed meshes, per the released config paths.
- 05-08: preprocessing pipeline internalized so artists can bring their own meshes with label ply files.
- 06-08: pilot with the asset team — 5 production meshes, artist-rated quality.

Daniela owns staffing; Hyun is TL. Flag data/platform dependencies early — the preprocessing step touches Corpus storage.

Priya
